blocks.text: Proteins bare aur complex (pecheeda) macromolecules (bohat bare molecules) hain jo tamam jaandaron mein bohat zyada miqdar mein milte hain. Hamari jild (skin), baal, khoon ka haemoglobin (laal rang wala maadda) aur muscles, sab proteins hain. Jism mein proteins ke ahem kaam hain: tissues ka dhaancha banane se le kar cells aur organs (aaza) ke mukhtalif kaamon tak. Kisi protein ki banawat ya kaam mein koi bhi tabdeeli jism ko abnormal (ghair maamooli) bana sakti hai.
Jab proteins ki mukammal hydrolysis ki jaye to amino acids milte hain. Taqreeban 20 mukhtalif amino acids mukhtalif sequences (tarteebon) mein jur kar bohat qisam ke proteins banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Mukammal hydrolysis par proteins kya dete hain?

items: Proteins: amino acids se bane bare molecules; jild, baal, haemoglobin aur muscles proteins hain.
Taqreeban 20 amino acids mukhtalif tarteebon mein jur kar mukhtalif proteins banate hain.
